# The MOUSE action removed the green blocks above the avatar!
# Now let me find all remaining green blocks and remove them
ascii = current_frame.ascii
lines = ascii.split('\n')

# Find all green (N) blocks

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    for j, ch in enumerate(line):
        if ch == 'N':
            green_positions.append((i, j))

print(f"Found {len(green_positions)} green block cells")
# Group them by proximity
if green_positions:
    # Print unique rows with green blocks
    green_rows = sorted(set(r for r, c in green_positions))
    for r in green_rows:
        cols = sorted(c for rr, c in green_positions if rr == r)

# Check remaining green blocks

    for j, ch in enumerate(line):
        if ch == 'N':
            green_positions2.append((i, j))
print(f"Remaining green blocks: {len(green_positions2)}")
if green_positions2:
